method: Rendered all four final PDFs with pdftoppm -r 135 -png and visually inspected all six pages after the final Chinese Lift wording and LDGI description refinement. All three selected works lead with findings; Lift retains clean-training/noisy-testing conditions, content-adaptive 1D-to-2D lift, task-prioritized loss scheduling, 3.13% sampling, 20 dB Gaussian measurement noise, three simulated datasets and optical-bench proof of concept. Checked hierarchy, spacing, line wrapping, glyphs, clipping, overlap, portrait clearance and page footers. Original font sizes, leading, bounds and 2/1/2/1 page counts are preserved. Refreshed all six 100-dpi .qa/cv overview thumbnails from these same PDFs.
html_visual_qa: Not separately reviewed; HTML CVs are unlinked companions of the reviewed PDFs.
